verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe Experiments as the immutable, comparable record of eval runs, used to track progress and catch regressions. Playgrounds let users run full evaluations and compare results side by side across prompts and models, and evals can run in CI/CD on every pull request to catch regressions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the experiment diff view (e.g., per-test-case regression highlighting or score deltas between runs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison workflow.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Experiments are the immutable, comparable record of your eval runs. Run them from code or in the UI, track progress over time, and integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production.
